name: Journal
source:
Journal is a semi-linear, romance, fantasy visual novel with a major focus on character growth and daily life struggles. 

You’ll follow the life of Lucas, an 18-year old trying to forget the past and move on from painful experiences. 

At first, it all appears better with the protagonist adapting to his new school and living his teen life, but when a certain event triggers, things that shouldn’t be possible occur yet again, shaking our reality as it is. 

[From [url=https://alessdreem.itch.io/journal]Itch.io[/url]]
